[!GOOS:linux] skip 'assembly syscall fixture uses the Linux syscall ABI'
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'assembly syscall fixture uses amd64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/asmsys$GOEXE .
stderr '\[capabilities::unclassified_assembly\]'
stderr 'example\.com/amain'
stderr '-> example\.com/adep'
! stderr '\[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\]'
cp ../granted.toml logos.toml
logos build -o $WORK/bin/asmsys$GOEXE .
! stderr 'capabilities::'
exec $WORK/bin/asmsys$GOEXE
stdout '^ok$'

-- main/go.mod --
module example.com/amain

go 1.27

require example.com/adep v0.0.0

replace example.com/adep => ../dep

-- main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe = "deny"

-- main/main.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/adep"
)

func main() {
	if adep.Pid() != os.Getpid() { panic("pid") }
	fmt.Println("ok")
}

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/adep

go 1.27

-- dep/pid.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package adep

func Pid() int

-- dep/pid_amd64.s --
#include "textflag.h"

TEXT ·Pid(SB), NOSPLIT, $0-8
	MOVQ $39, AX
	SYSCALL
	MOVQ AX, ret+0(FP)
	RET

-- granted.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe = "deny"
transitive_unsafe_allowlist = ["example.com/adep/**"]
